rationale: Freeze the KAN-268 regression surface before source work. The Worker file that is ACTUALLY DEPLOYED is project/static/_worker.js (proven by its unique X-Cost-Guardrail / X-R2-Policy response headers, which appear nowhere else in the repo). It declared `const BACKEND_BASE_URL = 'https://pphothidaen-horoconsultant-core-backend.hf.space'`, a module-level const that shadowed wrangler.toml's [vars] BACKEND_BASE_URL, so every config-only fix was a silent no-op and the live Worker proxied to a retired, PAUSED HF Space (HTTP 503) while the documented PRIMARY backend, Render (https://horoconsultant-core-backend.onrender.com), returned HTTP 200. The behavioural node tests invoke the real worker module with a stubbed global fetch, so a change that alters configuration without altering runtime routing cannot pass them; the python tests pin the source contract and the two wrangler origins. This also supersedes the false premise of PR #153, which renamed the Worker and swapped its entry point, breaking the repo's own contract tests.
